findings.summary: Traceability Gap: Sample check links Requirement R1/AT1 to Milestone M2, but the Candidate Plan only verifies AT1 in Milestone M1.

evidence.note: Milestone M1 includes AT1 in exit criteria as expected.
evidence.quote: AT1 passes: valid plan accepted; chat logs and non-canonical inputs rejected.

evidence.note: Milestone M2 exit criteria lists parallel execution tests (AT12, AT13, etc.) but does not verify the foundational intake test AT1.

findings.summary: Traceability Gap: Sample check links Requirement R2/AT2 to Milestone M2, but the Candidate Plan only verifies AT2 in Milestone M1.

evidence.note: Milestone M1 includes AT2 in exit criteria as expected.
evidence.quote: AT2 passes: missing/invalid repo_context.json rejected; valid repo_context.json accepted.

evidence.note: Milestone M2 relies on repo_context but does not include the AT2 schema validation gate in its exit criteria.
